The north also contains large docks in the north east and the city's airport in the north south

entries.name: City South
entries.content: The south of Islaport is almost entirely filled with suburban neighborhoods and parks in tight knit neighborhoods, in the northern part of the district there are a few businesses such as Fresh Mart Supermarket and Golden Fried Chicken

entries.name: City West
entries.content: The West of Islaport is infamous for it's poorer communities and high crime rates, there are very few businesses due to thievery. The west also holds many industrial buildings like warehouses and the city's power station

entries.name: Club Nightshade
entries.content: The most popular nightclub in the city of Islaport, known for its high energy atmosphere. There are rumors that the nightclub is owned by the Italian mafia and many of its members attend the nightclub.

entries.name: Coastside Golf Course
entries.content: The Coastside Golf Course is the premier 18-hole golf course in Islaport. It's located just outside the north side of the city, next to "The Stumbling Horse" restaurant. It is part of the Golden Sand Country Club and incorporates a small lake. The refreshing sea breeze from the ocean makes it one of the most popular golf courses in the region

entries.name: Colonel Pier
entries.content: A large Pier in the north west of Islaport's beach and the pier in which the famous "Ocean Realm" amusement park is located

entries.name: Common Rock Car Wash
entries.content: A small car wash located in the south of Islaport, nearby a mechanic. It's a small car wash known for hiring students in the summertime

entries.name: Copper Estate
entries.content: A large estate owned by the wealthy Copper Family, located in the eastern section of the city. The estate is made up mostly of buildings that serve various purposes like maid housing, garages and storage space. The main building is a large and old mansion.

entries.name: Corner Store
entries.content: Located within the acre yard neighbourhood in the west of Islaport, it's a small family owned corner store with various groceries, snacks and drinks for people to buy

entries.name: Cream Station
entries.content: A small ice cream parlor on the boardwalk that sells ice cream of various flavours and sizes, each with their own unique names such as Blueberry Spring

entries.name: Elko Terrace
entries.content: An expansive, peaceful neighborhood in the south of Islaport. it is mostly occupied by middle class families of the nearby Greenwich High's students

entries.name: Elm Street Mansion
entries.content: Elm Street Mansion, aka Atwood Hall, south of Islaport near Greenwich High School, gothic structure: overgrown gardens, wrought-iron gate, crumbling facade, ivy-covered walls, broken windows. Inside: dusty antique furniture, cobwebbed chandeliers, creaky floors, dark hallways, hidden rooms. Known as haunted by locals, especially Greenwich High students; site of dares, urban legends, hauntings are myths. Owned by Eleanor Atwood, inherited by great niece Angelica Atwood, plans to restore for community use. Central to investigation by Senior Detective Demi Reed, key evidence in 15-year-old Bonnie Bennett murder cold-case. Angelica aims to clear family name, uncover secrets

entries.name: Empire Highschool
entries.content: A low funded Highschool in the western part of the city. The school is infamous for its delinquent students who cause trouble around the city, getting into gang fights and damaging public property.

entries.name: Evergreen Community Center
entries.content: A community center located in the south of Islaport that's commonly used for group activities, social support, events, and other purposes.

entries.name: Flamed Feast
entries.content: A barbeque restaurant in the boardwalk, it is famous for it's quality barbeque meals and large boar sign above the entrance

entries.name: Food Stands
entries.content: Along the boardwalk there are many food stands selling a variety of treats and snacks such as hotdogs and fries

entries.name: Fort Plaza Police Station
entries.content: The city's main police station. It's a large building with a dedicated armory, offices and attached parking complex for police vehicles. There is also a holding section for criminals.

entries.name: Founder's Statue
entries.content: Outside the main entrance of the Town Hall is the famous large bronze statue of the city founder, Howard Small, erected in 1823

entries.name: Fresh Mart
entries.content: Fresh Mart is a large supermarket in the south of Islaport, bordering the city centre. It's commonly used by nearby neighbourhoods for weekly grocery shopping, the store has many aisles and sections filled with various products as well as a bakery and butcher section.

entries.name: Game Globe
entries.content: A game store located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells a variety of video games, electronics and merchandise. The store has recently started offering pre-built gaming computers as more media goes digital.

entries.name: Gauntlet Corporation
entries.content: Gauntlet Corporation is the biggest businesses and insurance company in Islaport, handling various claims like house, car and life insurance as well as pensions and investments

entries.name: Gauntlet Offices
entries.content: A large office building in the centre of Islaport, with almost 45 floors of office space. Most commuters in the city work in this building

entries.name: Giuliani Contruction
entries.content: A small-time construction company situated in a trailer on a plot of land in the west of Islaport. The trailer serves as the de facto Headquarters of the company, which doesn't see much business.

entries.name: Gold Bison Bank
entries.content: Gold Bison Bank: City centre, opulent marble building like the Parthenon, large golden letters, highly secure, many guards and cameras. Inside: polished, teller stations with bulletproof glass. Vault below: gold, cash, safety deposit boxes, reputed unbreakable

entries.name: Golden Fried Chicken
entries.content: A popular fast food franchise around Islaport, loved for its family friendly atmosphere and tasty food. Advertisements are often shown and its owner, Inaya, is well known across the city

entries.name: Golden Sands Country Club
entries.content: A large and grand country club most often entered by the wealthiest in Islaport. Located in the east of the city, it has a large golf course, tennis courts and lounge areas with a built-in bar. The club requires membership or a guest pass to be used

entries.name: Goldenrock Station
entries.content: A clean, elevated train station that is located on the eastern side of the city, it is mostly used by older residents and students.

entries.name: Grayfield Community College
entries.content: Grayfield is an underfunded community college in the west of Islaport. The student body is made up of the few Empire Highschool students that pass and adults taking various night classes. The college's equipment is of very poor quality and unmaintained and the building is run down

entries.name: Green Mile Bakery & Cafe
entries.content: Green Mile Bakery & Cafe is located one block eastward from Greenwich High School. It is a small bakery/cafe that is widely frequented by Greenwich students on their way to school due to the popularity of its fresh baked goods and roasted in-house coffee. It also has become a popular spot for students skipping school.

entries.name: Greenmarsh Fishery
entries.content: A small fishing area on the eastern bank of Bamboo Lagoon, consisting of a few shacks and a pier.

entries.name: Greenwich Highschool
entries.content: A large reputable highschool in the south of the city, surrounded by suburbs. It mostly accepts students with average grades, though recently it's quality of education has begun to decline

entries.name: Hall of Cards
entries.content: A card shop located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells collectable trading cards and tabletop gaming products. The shop's owner, Clyde, often hosts video game tournaments and many visitors play tabletop games in the store.

entries.name: Happy Paws
entries.content: A veterinary clinic in the southern section of the city. Happy Paws is well regarded and praised for it's welcoming atmosphere and animal loving staff.

entries.name: Harvest Hall
entries.content: A large and old mansion in the eastern fields of the city. Harvest Hall is a very historical building that now serves as a venue for various events, it's most popular for weddings.

entries.name: Healthline Pharmacy
entries.content: A small local pharmacy situated in the south of Islaport that sells pharmaceutical and prescription drugs, as well as general hygiene and beauty products.

entries.name: Hit Happens
entries.content: A mixed martial arts gym located in the city's west side that occasionally hosts free classes for low-income and at-risk youths.

entries.name: Islaport Boardwalk
entries.content: A large boardwalk running along the beaches of Islaport, from the Pier in the north west to the docks in the north west

entries.name: Islaport City
entries.content: Islaport is a large coastal city with a range of attractions and suburbs and a population of 700,000. It is well known for its expansive beach and bustling city centre

entries.name: Islaport Freeway
entries.content: The Islaport Freeway is a large and busy highway that crosses through the city from the East to West, connecting Islaport to many different cities

entries.name: Islaport High Street
entries.content: The cities bustling high street, a narrow walkway passing many shops, cafés and restaurants and leading to the cities marketplace

entries.name: Islaport Marine Research Institute
entries.content: Located on the western part of the coastline, Islaport's Marine Research Institute is made up of various labs that analyse the health of the ocean's ecosystems and ensure human waste does not damage the ocean's environments.

entries.name: Islaport Museum of Natural History
entries.content: A museum located in the City Centre containing historical artifacts and taxidermy animals. It has several wings, including exhibits for dinosaurs, animals, prehistoric humans, and geology and minerals.  The top floor is dedicated entirely to a space exhibit.  A historical observatory is open for visitors at night. The star of the museum is the exhibit on wildlife found in the ocean around the city

entries.name: Islaport Public Library
entries.content: Islaport Public Library is a grand and historical building that holds many books, new and old. It has three wings, the main wing, a children's wing on the left and a historical wing on the right. Despite its age it has been modernised with computers and printers, the building is open to anyone to use and mostly visited by older adults and children

entries.name: Islaport Town Hall
entries.content: The Town Hall of Islaport, a large historic building, is in the city center opposite the central station subway. Its ornate exterior features tall windows. Inside, a marble-floored lobby leads to a grand hall for events. The second floor has modern offices for municipal departments. The Town Hall symbolizes local governance, hosting civic events, cultural activities, and tours

entries.name: Karaoke Kizuna
entries.content: A karaoke bar hidden within Islaport's High Street where people can rent out a room to sing various songs, it's an extremely popular spot for students and office workers.

entries.name: Kuroniku
entries.content: A Japanese restaurant in the High Street that specializes in yakiniku that's beloved by students for its cheap prices. It's rumored to have a secret menu, but even the most dedicated customers don't know how to get access to it.

entries.name: Lake Howard
entries.content: A small lake in the eastern fields of the city, named after the city founder Howard Small.

entries.name: Lake Night Train Station
entries.content: A train station located in the west of Islaport that has an infamous reputation for the frequent criminal activity that occurs. The police and government have been trying to crack down on the crime and help revitalize the station's image.

entries.name: Lawn Street Station
entries.content: A train station located on the north of Islaport that's frequently busy due to the number of beachgoers arriving via train. The station has a problem with the constant littering in the area.

entries.name: Lectrix Clothes
entries.content: A clothing store located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells a large variety of clothes at a reasonable price. It's one of the most popular and visited stores in Pyramid Mall.

entries.name: Lux Les Flame
entries.content: A fine dining establishment on the cities High Street. Famous for it's high prices and tasty food, it mostly serves french cuisine and wine

entries.name: Madame Fit
entries.content: A clothing and beauty shop located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells lingerie and perfumes.

entries.name: Mark and Daughter
entries.content: A small family business that specializes in elevator engineering and repairs, the workers consisting of the owner, Mark and his daughter, Avery.

entries.name: Mayor's Office
entries.content: The Town Hall mayors office is a spacious room with many historical paintings around, antique furniture and a large window looking over the city centre. The office is occasionally open to tourists

entries.name: Merry Lime Bar
entries.content: A shoddy bar in the western side of Islaport. Its patronage is mainly made of factory workers and the downtrodden. The bar is also a popular location for prostitutes and often visited by a biker gang known as the Brimstone Riders.

entries.name: Mr. Kim Detective Agency
entries.content: A detective agency located on the south of Islaport. The agency deals with a large variety of cases, from infidelity to murders and even conspiracies.

entries.name: Namsan Pavilion
entries.content: A well-known traditional Korean restaurant in the High Street that's owned by a sweet elderly lady. Their kimchi is infamous for its sheer spiciness.

entries.name: Nanikotan Sands Casino
entries.content: located along the waterfront of Cannon Bay; modern upscale casino owned and operated by the local Nanikotan native American tribe; cultural decor and art installations; spacious gaming floor; multiple restaurants and bars with beachfront views; event spaces; live performances; Nanikotan heritage gallery and cultural nights

entries.name: Oasis Apartments
entries.content: A pair of large apartment complexes located in Northern Islaport with beautiful ocean views, each having 12 floors. Many people of different backgrounds have made their home here

entries.name: Ocean Realm
entries.content: A large theme park located on the cities northern pier, it is open yearly and always filled with tourists. The rides consist of a Ferris wheel, rollar coaster, haunted house and many different booths with different games, all of which are ocean themed

entries.name: Ocean Water Luxury Hotel
entries.content: Ocean Water Luxury Hotel is a large hotel on the beachfront, famous for it's expensive rooms and additional escort services. The hotel has a large catalogue of suites and rentable escorts customers can pay to have sex with.

entries.name: Octobowl!
entries.content: An ocean themed bowling alley in the north of Islaport, it is a beloved business and regularly used by tourists and locals alike. Octobowl also contains a sizable arcade and a few Snooker tables guests can use

entries.name: Old Lighthouse
entries.content: An old Lighthouse on the north western edge of the Islaport Coastline, most often used as a romantic stop for couples due to it's beautiful view and easy access

entries.name: Olympian Gym
entries.content: A large gym located on the eastern side of Islaport visited by many people from different walks of life. It has many floors consisting of gym equipment, locker rooms, a swimming pool, and even a café. The gym also holds yoga classes.

entries.name: Pink Party Hotel
entries.content: A love hotel in the west of Islaport, bordering the city centre. The hotel is neat and clean despite the ghetto surrounding it, with cutesy and pink themed rooms and halls

entries.name: Pixelport Arcade
entries.content: Pixelport Arcade is a medium sized Arcade in the suburbs of south Islaport. It borders the western part of the city and is mostly used by Greenwich and Empire Highschool students.  It features games like Alley Brawl, Gotta go Fast, and Goose Shoot.  There are a variety of other games and pinball machines.

entries.name: Plush Builder
entries.content: A cutesy store in Pyramid Mall that sells stuffed toys customers can put together themselves

entries.name: Promontory Point Mountain Trail
entries.content: Promontory Point Mountain Trail is a trail that snakes through the forests on the eastern side of Islaport, terminating at an overlook on the peak of the mountain, allowing breathtaking views of the city and ocean.  There are several paths of varying difficulty. While the trail is quite popular, some sections are isolated.

entries.name: Pyramid Mall
entries.content: A massive mall located in the centre of the city, containing hundreds of different shops like Athlete Needs, GameGlobe and Pet Lovers. The mall also has its own dedicated Food Court and underground parking lot below.

entries.name: Rainbow Sun Daycare
entries.content: A nice daycare located in the south of the city, directly next to Borough Elementary School. The daycare is fitted with various pieces of play equipment and supplies to entertain young children for hours.

entries.name: Red Fox Stripclub
entries.content: Red Fox Stripclub is a club located in the west of the city. It is a very popular establishment and rarely disrupted, due to being the main base of a Motorcycle Gang known as the Brimstone Riders.

entries.name: Reefway Public Pool
entries.content: Reefway is Islaports public pool is located in the south eastern corner of the city centre, it's often used by families and locals who aren't able to afford gym memberships. Entry is free

entries.name: River Ando
entries.content: A pristine and beautiful river that runs past the west side of Islaport and into the ocean, becoming choked with sludge and other pollutants as it passes by the industrial park

entries.name: Rusty Wrench Auto Repair
entries.content: Located in western Islaport; legitimate auto repair shop, but also known to operate as a chop shop for stolen cars; clients include both regular customers and those seeking discreet vehicle modifications

entries.name: Saint Fries
entries.content: Saint Fries is a fast food chain restaurant located in the food court of Pyramid Mall at the center of Islaport. They're famous for their churros and fries.

entries.name: Shark Bay Correctional Center
entries.content: A medium-security prison just outside the western edge of the city. It holds local and national criminals.

entries.name: Shepard's Garden Church
entries.content: A large chapel located in the South of Islaport. Shepard's Garden is a popular church among the local community. The church also has an attached Catholic Orphanage where Nuns take care of unwanted or orphaned children.

entries.name: Shepherd's Garden Cemetery
entries.content: Located directly next the Shepard's Garden Church, the cemetery is a spacious and green area that is well looked after by it's caretakers.

entries.name: Silver Springs Nursing Home
entries.content: A nursing home surrounded by a peaceful suburban neighborhood. Elders are well taken care of by its professional staff and occasional volunteers.

entries.name: Silverlight Cinema
entries.content: The cities largest cinema, located in the north. It has a large reception and 10 expansive screen rooms where the latest blockbuster films are shown

entries.name: Sleek Sip
entries.content: A homely seaside café on the boardwalk, famous with students due to it's baristas mainly being flirty and attractive women

entries.name: Stumbling Horse Restaurant
entries.content: A family owned restaurant, the owner is a playful woman named Bailey. The restaurant is well known for its comfy atmosphere and tasty, but expensive, food. The restaurant has a beer garden overlooking Lake Howard

entries.name: Sunset Point
entries.content: A calm, wide beach facing west on a promontory in northern Islaport. Accessed by a coastal path, it offers a serene escape from the city, with hidden tidal pools and vibrant marine life

entries.name: Swim Wears
entries.content: A clothing store on the boardwalk that sells clothing for swimming such as bikinis, shorts and swimming costumes. The store also sells wetsuits and scuba gear, though have high prices

entries.name: The Munition Den
entries.content: Located in the west, The Munition Den is a gun store sheltered between factories and warehouses. It sells a variety of guns and other weapons such as knives and bullet proof vests, in the back of the shop is a large shooting range

entries.name: Thunder Cola Factory
entries.content: A large industrial facility in Westside Industrial Park that manufactures and bottles the popular Thunder Cola soft drink. The factory runs 24/7 with loud machinery and a towering smokestack

entries.name: Top Notch Auto Mechanics
entries.content: A reputable mechanic shop known for it's friendly owner, Giles, who recently passed away located in the south of Islaport.

entries.name: Vapour Hole
entries.content: A small vape store on the boardwalk, known for it's punk aesthetic and goth owner. The customer base is largely younger students

entries.name: Velvet Auditorium
entries.content: An elegant theater found in the north part of Islaport that specializes in Shakespearean and original plays, as well as orchestral performances. The building is a modernized take on the Globe Theatre. Despite having a niche market, it has a tight-knit community and working here is a theater kid's dream.

entries.name: Waterfall Art College
entries.content: Waterfall Art College is located in the City Center. It is the premier educational outlet for young adults to hone their artistic talents. Theatrical, filmography, and graphic design courses are also available. The college offers on-campus housing to its students

entries.name: Wesson Hills
entries.content: A wealthy neighborhood located in the eastern part of the city, filled with expensive mansions and modern homes.

entries.name: Westpoint Speedway
entries.content: Thriving raceway in the western part of the city. Hosts various motorsport events, including stock car racing and drag racing. Popular attraction for racing enthusiasts and spectators alike

entries.name: Westside Industrial Park
entries.content: West Islaport. Factories, warehouses, logistics centers. Heavy truck traffic, machinery. Major blue-collar jobs. Key industries: manufacturing, shipping, food processing. Separated from residential areas

entries.name: Wetland Line Station
entries.content: Wetland Line is the south section of Islaport's train line, it is outside and rather peaceful. The station is almost entirely used by white collar workers and students

entries.name: Whitewater Medical School
entries.content: Located directly next to the city's hospital, Whitewater is a highly praised medical school with many classrooms and supplies to create the best surgeons around. Whitewater also has its own dorm building.

entries.name: Winton College & University
entries.content: The most prestigious college in Islaport. However, despite its reputation, the college has faced criticism for not ensuring high-paying careers for all students after graduation.

entries.name: Wistful Tailors
entries.content: A small wedding dress tailor shop located on the city's High Street, it is well regarded for it's quality and used by almost all engaged couples.

entries.name: Immegram
entries.content: Immegram is a social media platform where users can upload various photos and selfies they take and comment on others. It's incredibly popular and largely used by youths and models.

entries.name: Flashchat
entries.content: Flashchat is a messaging and photo-sharing app where users can send pictures or videos with captions to recipients, who can view them for only a limited time before they become inaccessible.

entries.name: LovePharm
entries.content: LovePharm is a drug company and conglomerate founded by Herbert Milo. It owns and operates nearly all pharmacies in Islaport, with its main office located in the city center.

entries.name: Private Fans
entries.content: A pornography website where anyone can create an account and create their own amatuer videos for followers who can donate to their accounts. In recent years, Private Fans has become very popular.

entries.name: Islaport International Airport
entries.content: A massive airport located on the south western section of Islaport's coastline, it has many large runaways and rentable hangars where civilians aircrafts can be stored. The airport is infamous for its delays and strict security.

entries.name: Central Station
entries.content: A large train station in the very centre of the city, used mostly by office workers, students and tourists. It has trains that run both throughout the city and beyond.

entries.name: Shima Sentai Umiranger
entries.content: Shima Sentai Umiranger, better known by its English name, Ocean Rangers, is a famous Japanese TV show that promotes environmental awareness. Despite its Japanese roots, episodes are often filmed in Islaport.

entries.name: Bus Station
entries.content: A large bus station in the centre of the city, the buses run mainly through the city and it's different sectors. The bus station also has tourist buses that run through the more interesting sections of the city for tourists.

entries.name: Grandside Business School
entries.content: Grandside Business School is a well-regarded college located in the east of the city, known for its strong emphasis on practical business skills. It offers in-depth courses designed to help students excel in fields like finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship.

entries.name: Casa Alfonso
entries.content: Casa Alfonso is a welcoming Italian restaurant located in the east of the city, popular for their wood-fired pizza and tiramisu. The owner, Alfonso, is known for his warm-heartedness and kindness towards his patrons and employees.

entries.name: Marketplace
entries.content: A large marketplace in the city centre, filled with sizeable stalls rented by businesses to sell products, produce, food, and drinks. Some stalls also offer a wide variety of goods from different cultures and countries.*

entries.name: Med Sector
entries.content: A medical drama show featuring many famous actors and famously thrilling scenes. Many complaints have risen about the show's age and constant renewals.

entries.name: Adebate
entries.content: A social media platform where users can create servers to message and voice chat with their friends. The platform is very popular and mostly used by Gamers.

entries.name: Rocky's Refuge
entries.content: Rocky's Refuge is a homeless shelter located in the west of the city, providing a safe haven for those in need. It offers warm meals, temporary housing, and essential resources, including job counseling and job placement services.

entries.name: Call of War
entries.content: An incredibly popular video game in the first person shooter genre. With a variety of game modes, the game has millions of players who love to play against each other in PvP lobbies.
